parent_links.lineage: one DAgger round (Ross et al., 2011) for the six #136/#138 choice-frontier adapters: on-policy rollouts on #136 training tasks labelled by the exact heap-head teacher, continue-training on the aggregate, evaluation on the #135 panel and the #139 P2 panel, pooled pre-registered separation test against the exact-eps-0.75 rung

arms_source: configs/experiments/choice-frontier-v4/seeds-protocol.json arms.visual-choice-frontier (unchanged; asserted against examples/planning_benchmark_slice/choice_frontier.py constants by validate)

base_policies.rule: adapter (algorithm, seed) is the base policy for its own collection and its own continue-training cell

collection.cells: 6 = 2 algorithms x seeds {17, 29, 71}; one GPU job per cell (cfv5-collect-<algorithm>-s<seed>)
collection.training_tasks: configs/experiments/choice-frontier-v3/training-tasks.json rows with excluded == false, walked in file (#136 frozen walk) order
task_filters_in_order: exclusion: problem_sha256 in the #135 candidates (configs/experiments/choice-frontier-v2/candidates.json) or in the #139 candidates (configs/experiments/choice-frontier-v4/candidates.json, every row including rejected overlaps) -> skipped, reason candidate_overlap; the runner asserts that no rolled-out task matches either set

views: the task needs its frozen #136 derivation episode (outputs/choice-frontier/v3/preparation/episodes/<task>.json.gz) and #136 scene-only train views (outputs/choice-frontier/v3/train-views/<task>/result.json, TRAIN_VIEWS_PASS); otherwise skipped, reason no_136_views (the #136 visual observation contract exists only for these tasks)
reference: R_task >= 1; otherwise skipped, reason zero_reference_expansions
collection.filter_note: the #139 generation rejected 267 candidates as problem_sha256 overlaps with #136 training tasks; those training tasks match a #139 candidate row and are skipped so that no rollout touches a problem that ever entered the #139 candidate pool
collection.reference_expansions: R_task = number of decisions with status 'expanded' in the #136 uncapped exact_reference derivation episode for the algorithm (every #136 derivation episode is complete)
collection.decision_cap: 2 x R_task (decision and expansion cap, the frozen contract)
collection.session: ChoiceFrontierModelSession arm process_sft, seed 17 (inference seed), adapter_id = base adapter path, greedy decoding, the #136 inference settings
collection.views: ChoiceFrontierTaskViews over the frozen #136 train views (static pages, goal pages, pre-rendered teacher scenes, read-only); unseen states rendered live by the planimation backend at http://127.0.0.1:18092 into outputs/choice-frontier/v5/collection/views/<task>/<algorithm>-s<seed>
collection.model_calls: the adapter is called at every decision of the frozen contract (menu size 1 included); its own choice drives the rollout
collection.record_rule: every decision whose menu has >= 2 states yields a record: menu binding, state-index binding and page sources exactly as the model saw them, the teacher label and whether the adapter agreed
collection.teacher_label: the menu label of controller.frontier_head_state_id() on the current (on-policy) frontier, i.e. minimum (priority, generation serial) — computed before the adapter's choice is submitted
collection.agreement: parsed expand_choice of the raw output == teacher label (unparseable output counts as disagreement; the record is kept)
collection.observation_overflow: if the observation of a decision exceeds the 32K context (OBSERVATION_OVERFLOW), the episode stops there with termination observation_overflow and that decision yields no record
collection.stop_rule: run complete episodes in walk order until the cell holds >= 1024 records (first 32 per episode); build-corpus takes the first 1024 in walk/episode order (the last episode may contribute partially); if the walk is exhausted first, use every record if >= 512, otherwise blocked exit
collection.replay: audit-collect independently replays every collected episode (inputs, menus, view bindings, runtime results, result, overflow stop) and recomputes every teacher label as the heap head of the replayed frontier

corpus.per_cell: the on-policy records of (algorithm, seed) + 1024 records sampled without replacement from the frozen #136 corpus of the algorithm

augmentation.target: the teacher state's label after permutation

corpus.sample_order: samples = [(record_id, copy) for record_id in on_policy_ids + replay_ids for copy in (0, 1)], then random.Random(f'order:dagger:{algorithm}:{seed}').shuffle(samples), then sequential
corpus.diagnostic_split: the frozen #136 diagnostic records of the algorithm (16, unaugmented; teacher-forced loss only)
corpus.membership: configs/experiments/choice-frontier-v5/membership.json (record ids per cell, sample counts, membership_sha256), committed and pushed before any training
corpus.store: outputs/choice-frontier/v5/preparation/store.json (on-policy records with their page sources); replay records are read from outputs/choice-frontier/v3/preparation/store.json
corpus.token_check: every training sample's recomputed input tokens equal the tokens stored with its record

training.init: continue training the base adapter (algorithm, seed): PeftModel.from_pretrained(base, is_trainable=True); fresh optimizer and scheduler
training.audit: loaded-from path == base adapter, r == 64, alpha == 128, dropout == 0.05, steps == ceil(samples / 32) (128 at 4096), seed, sample count == membership
training.concurrency: two cells at a time, one per GPU, distinct MASTER_PORT

smoke_gate.subset_rule: three cheapest tasks of the frozen 9-task panel (the #132 smoke definition)
smoke_gate.measure: schema_valid_grounded_rate = accepted calls / total calls across the 6 episodes
smoke_gate.rule: PASS iff rate >= 0.5; FAIL gates every DAgger evaluation out and the verdict is SMOKE_FAIL

evaluation.decision_cap: 2 x R_t, R_t = membership reference_costs[alg]['expansions'] (the #135/#139 uncapped exact expansions)
evaluation.views: native views read-only from the panel view report; live renders under outputs/choice-frontier/v5/evaluation/<panel>/views
evaluation.replay: finalize independently replays every episode of both panels; 0 missing, 0 mismatches

reused_not_rerun.optimal_costs: #135 outputs/choice-frontier/v2/metrics/optimal-costs.json; P2 recomputed by the #139 shortest_plan and asserted against the frozen C*

evaluation.wait_rule: if the #139 P2 learned/zoo evidence is not complete at analysis, wait for #139 to close (poll gh issue view 139 --json state, ~10 min sleeps)

analysis.metric_functions: imported: scripts/analyze_choice_frontier_v2.py (inspect_episode, summarize, bootstrap, percentile), scripts/analyze_choice_frontier_v4_panels.py (panel_data, model_rows, zoo_rows), scripts/analyze_choice_frontier_v4_seeds.py (seed_averaged_bootstrap, separation_verdict), scripts/analyze_choice_frontier_v3.py (verdict)
analysis.pooled_tasks: 23 = #135 panel (12) + P2 (11); task ids disjoint (asserted); clustered by task
analysis.m1_per_task_seed: M1 per task and training seed = the #135 summarize per-task AUC (mean over the two algorithms)

bootstrap.within_draw: resample the 23 tasks with replacement; average the seeds inside each draw

primary.estimand: S_pool = M1(DAgger, 3-seed mean) - M1(exact-eps-0.75, averaged over its 5 seeds), pooled 23 tasks
primary.smoke_fail: SMOKE_FAIL if the seed-17 DAgger smoke gate fails

co_primary.estimand: Delta_pool = M1(DAgger) - M1(pre-DAgger), paired by (task, algorithm, seed), 3-seed mean, pooled 23 tasks, same bootstrap

secondary_descriptive: per panel: S, Delta and D3 = M1(DAgger) - M1(random_valid) under the #138 rule
per-seed M1 with CI (per panel and pooled)

estimand.name: choice_frontier_v5_dagger_estimand
estimand.training_gpu_hours: 6 x 4096 x 2.75 s ~= 19 (#136 measured 1.9 GPU-h per 4096-sample cell)

budget.cross_ledger_rule: while outputs/choice-frontier/v4/budget.json has any reserved or running attempt, launch only on a GPU that attempt does not hold and whose nvidia-smi memory.used is < 1 GB
budget.fallback: if the scheduler would exceed 40 GPU-h, drop evaluation cells in the order seed 71, then seed 29, and report the dropped cells

execution_contract.relaunch: infrastructure failures only, at most 2 relaunches per job, recipe never changes
execution_contract.completion_hook_fix: hooks derive the attempt dir from EXPANDED_TERMINAL_PATH's parent (the #136 fix)

declared_code_surface: examples/planning_benchmark_slice/visual_model.py (train_visual gains an optional init_adapter argument; default behaviour unchanged)
